snapshot.title: Serve the embedded GUI from the daemon
snapshot.description:
Mount `internal/webui` (the Vite build embedded from `internal/webui/dist`) at `/` in `internal/daemon`, behind the existing localhost Host check. `kiln serve` prints the GUI URL. Unknown paths fall back to `index.html` for client-side routing.

In development, `cd web && npm run dev` proxies Connect calls to the daemon (configure the Vite proxy).
